messages:
alyssa: Heads-up: NovaHealth POC goes live tomorrow. They want full audit visibility for the engineers and the test harness. Question: if we issue hosted API keys for POC, will those show up in their audit exports?

tariq: Are they doing Hosted or asking to spin Dedicated for the trial?

alyssa: Hosted for now. They'll need ephemeral user keys for devs + one service key for their CI/harness. Asking about retention (30 vs 90 days) and Splunk export options.

kevin (solutions-eng): Hosted keys are captured in our request audit stream. We log api_key_id, endpoint, model, token counts, latency, and source IP. We do not log raw prompt content unless customer opts in. For exports: we support S3 export, and can forward to Splunk via HEC or syslog -> kinesis/firehose -> s3.

kevin (solutions-eng): If they want us to push to their Splunk HEC, we need the HEC URL + token. Alternatively they can give an S3 bucket + cross-account role and we write ndjson to s3. We can create a temp bucket with lifecycle too.

security-bot: NOTE: Raw request/response bodies are opt-in. Enabling content capture requires DPA/NDA and explicit consent.

maria (security): Correct. Metadata-only is default. For full bodies we need signed DPA and to enable encryption-at-rest with customer KMS or a managed CMK + key wrap if required for PHI. Also flag PII handling.

alyssa: They said "audit everything for debugging". I can propose opt-in but must call out the compliance steps.

tariq: For ephemeral keys we usually TTL to 24h for POCs. Ops can create via console or CLI: `redwood sessions create --ttl=86400`.

kevin (solutions-eng): For the harness service key recommend scoping (allowed routes) and disable cache/prefixing if they need deterministic logs. Also note: enabling full content logging increases storage and egress costs — call that out in SOW.

maria (security): If they want Splunk delivery, customer should provide HEC creds. If they prefer us to push, we need a short-lived cross-account role on their S3 with put permissions.

jess (sales-engineering): Draft POC checklist: 1) Issue ephemeral dev keys TTL=24h; 2) Create scoped service key for harness; 3) Decide metadata-only vs full bodies; 4) Customer provides Splunk HEC or S3 + role; 5) Retention term (30 default, 90 optional with addendum); 6) DPA/NDA for content; 7) Pricing addendum for >30d storage/egress.

alyssa: @NovaContact can you confirm whether you'll supply HEC token, or prefer S3? Also confirm retention preference (30 vs 90).

NovaContact: We can provide HEC. Prefer full bodies for debugging but understand constraints. 90 days preferred. Will sign DPA.

maria (security): If full bodies and 90d, propose customer-managed KMS or we use a dedicated CMK with HSM wrap. That becomes an optional line item.

tariq: FYI if they later migrate to Dedicated we can route logs into their VPC/S3 directly and keys can be reissued under dedicated account. Migration plan simple canary traffic shift.

kevin (solutions-eng): I'll estimate extra cost for 90-day retention + Splunk egress once they confirm daily request volume.

security-bot: ACTION: Security to queue DPA template and KMS options; await customer signature.

alyssa: I'll send the checklist + ask for HEC details and DPA signature. Will update thread when I hear back. Thanks all :thumbsup:
